# Code of Conduct

Mint-Setup is a small project maintained in spare time. To keep it a good place to take part, everyone who comments, opens an issue or sends a pull request is expected to:

- **Be respectful.** Disagreeing with an approach or a decision is fine; disrespecting the person who proposed it is not.
- **Be specific.** "This fails like this, in this environment, with these steps" helps far more than a general complaint.
- **Be patient.** The project is maintained out of personal interest, not as a full-time job, so replies may take a while.
- **Do not harass or discriminate.** Harassment, discriminatory comments and aggressive language toward other people in the project are not tolerated.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, close or delete issues, comments and pull requests that do not follow this code, and may block repeat offenders. If you witness or experience behavior that does not fit this code, write to the maintainer through the contact options on the GitHub profile [@filonux](https://github.com/filonux).
